text: Quickstart lets you build and run a working voice bot you can talk to in a browser in under 5 minutes
quote: Build and run your first Pipecat voice AI bot in under 5 minutes: a simple conversational agent you can talk to in a browser.

text: Bot stops speaking instantly and cancels in-flight work when user barges in, ready for new input
quote: Interruptions (also called barge-in) let the user talk over the bot. When the user starts speaking while the bot is talking, the bot stops immediately, in-flight work is cancelled

text: AudioBufferProcessor captures high-quality synchronized recordings of both user and bot audio
quote: Pipecat's \`AudioBufferProcessor\` makes it easy to capture high-quality audio recordings of both the user and bot during interactions.

text: Turn events let you collect user and assistant messages as they happen during a call
quote: Pipecat's turn events make it easy to collect both user and assistant messages as they occur.

text: Built-in metrics for STT/TTS can be turned on with simple config to track performance
quote: Pipecat offers built-in metrics for both, which can be enabled with straightforward configuration options.

text: Flow functions can process data by calling external systems and APIs mid-conversation
quote: Functions in Pipecat Flows serve two key purposes: 1. Process data ... 2. Progress the conversation by transitioning between nodes

text: Flow functions can progress the conversation by transitioning between defined nodes
quote: Functions in Pipecat Flows serve two key purposes: 1. Process data ... 2. Progress the conversation by transitioning between nodes

text: Built-in dev runner handles server glue: creating rooms, WebRTC offers, telephony websockets, and a prebuilt test UI
quote: Pipecat ships a built-in development runner (pipecat.runner.run) that handles the server-side glue most bots need during development: creating Daily rooms, accepting WebRTC offers, terminating telephony WebSockets, and serving a prebuilt UI

text: Pipecat Evals lets you describe a conversation and expected behavior, then runs it against your real agent
quote: You describe a conversation and the behavior you expect, and Pipecat runs it against your real agent (the same pipeline, the same services, the same code) and tells you whether the expectation still holds.

text: Smart Turn Detection uses an ML model to determine when a user has actually finished speaking
quote: Smart Turn Detection uses an advanced machine learning model to determine when a user has finished speaking and your bot should respond.

text: Pipecat Client SDKs handle real-time audio/video transport, session management, and events for web/mobile apps
quote: Pipecat Clients are a family of SDKs that connect users to your Pipecat agents through web and mobile applications. They handle real-time audio/video transport, session management, and provide messaging and events for building responsive vo

text: CLI command registers a context hub as an MCP server for your coding agent and builds a local index
quote: pipecat context-hub install registers the hub as an MCP server with your coding agent and builds the local index

text: Pipecat Cloud supports unlimited concurrency for scaling simultaneous calls
quote: Pipecat Cloud supports unlimited concurrency.

text: Telephony bots are triggered by inbound-call webhooks from carriers like Twilio, Telnyx, Plivo, Exotel, or a SIP provider
quote: the carrier (Twilio, Telnyx, Plivo, Exotel, or your SIP provider) is calling your webhook to tell you there's an inbound call

text: Swap speech, language, and vision providers across 200+ integrated services, usually with one line of code
quote: Swap speech, language, and vision services from any of 200+ integrated providers and services — usually one line of code.

text: Ships measured P99 latency values per supported service so turn detection can account for provider delay
quote: Pipecat ships with measured P99 latency values for each supported service so that turn detection can account for this delay automatically.

text: Official CLI installs and scaffolds a quickstart project, including agent-oriented docs files
quote: Install the Pipecat CLI and scaffold the quickstart project (also writes AGENTS.md + CLAUDE.md)

text: Provides pre-built React components for building voice AI interfaces
quote: Pre-built React components for voice AI interfaces.

text: Measures Time To Final Segment: latency from end of user speech to final STT transcript
quote: Time To Final Segment (TTFS) measures how long it takes from the moment a user stops speaking until the STT service delivers the final transcript.

text: Pipecat Cloud offers different agent compute profiles to match use case and scaling needs
quote: Pipecat Cloud offers different agent profiles, to best support your use case and compute needs.

text: Coordinates voice, video, text, and images in one pipeline with frame-level control over each step
quote: Coordinate voice, video, text, and images in one pipeline, with frame-level control over every step of the conversation.

text: Supports any transport type: WebRTC, SIP, and PSTN
quote: Any Transport: WebRTC, SIP, PSTN

text: Can build a single voice agent or a distributed multi-agent system with handoffs, parallel fan-out, and a shared coordination bus
quote: Build a single voice agent or a full multi-agent system where specialists hand off, fan out in parallel, and coordinate over a shared bus, locally or distributed across processes and machines.

text: Same bot code is portable unchanged across the dev runner, Pipecat Cloud, and self-hosted production setups
quote: This is the property that makes the same bot file portable across the development runner, Pipecat Cloud, and most production self-hosting setups.

text: Built-in noise suppression (powered by Krisp) eliminates background noise and false interruptions
quote: Eliminates background noise and voices that cause false interruptions, powered by Krisp.

text: Flows auto-derives function name, description, and parameter schema from the function's signature and docstring
quote: Flows auto-derives the function's metadata — name, description, parameter properties (with their descriptions), and which parameters are required — from the function's signature and docstring.

text: Bots can be run against real telephony providers like Twilio via a simple CLI flag and tunnel URL
quote: python bot.py -t twilio -x your-name.ngrok.io

text: Open-source Python framework that orchestrates 150+ AI services with ultra-low latency
quote: Open source Python framework for building voice and multimodal AI pipelines. Orchestrate 150+ AI services with ultra-low latency.

text: Supports handing off to subagents for long-running tasks while using Pipecat Flows for conversations that must follow a defined path
quote: Hand off to subagents for long-running tools and complex tasks, and use Pipecat Flows when a conversation needs to follow a defined path.
